newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amcor to build China carton factory.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amcor to build China carton factory.

text.p: Paper and packaging group Amcor Ltd said on Tuesday it would build a third folding carton factory in China.
Amcor said the plant, to be located in the southwestern city of Kunming, would be a joint venture with the Yunnan Tobacco Co with initial investment by the partners to total A$25 million.
When operating at full capacity, Amcor said the new plant would convert 6,000 tonnes of board and produce more than one billion hinge lid boxex per year.
By 3.15 p.m. (0515 GMT), Amcor shares were seven cents up at A$7.70 on turnover of 947,003 shares.
